said: Original issued: Ranger/Saber/Basher/Ace each HO*; puck dragged off the row, AL1 issued: all four 0; preview Original -> Load onto working copy: toast 'viewers still see AL1 until you publish', face AL1, 2 pending, puck + count 45 back, credits still 0 (Leave War grid and View-only face both unchanged); undo/redo/reload agree; AL2 restores HO* for all four. The OIL tracker sheet itself was not opened (Leave War grid read only).

Plan A / Plan B keep their own earning decision (A: 45 of 45; B: Ranger off, 44 of 45); switching plans on the published day changes nothing credited (all HO*) and reads 1 pending; undo/redo/reload agree; issuing Plan B as AL1 gives Ranger 0, Saber/Basher/Ace HO*. 'Switch to this plan' on a preview could NOT be reached: the plan preview exists only on View-only Sched (unpublished day, read only, no button); the edit week showed no preview bar after it, and the plans menu switches directly.

Three orders: before first issue credits 0; after issue HO*; an answer change after issue clears the four sign-offs and reads 1 pending while credits stay fixed; Undo restores the signatures and 0 pending, redo and reload agree; AL pays the new answer (Yes->No gives 0, No->Yes gives HO*). Phone repeat of order A identical.

Leave for Ranger after issue: working crowd 45 -> 44, issued credit stays (Leave War row keeps Ranger's 0.5 OIL figure and shows an LL clash banner) until AL1, then Ranger shows LL only and the figure drops to 0; reverse order (leave first, issue, remove leave) restores Ranger's HO* only at the AL. Undo/redo/reload agree each time.

Person change in the editor asks the OIL question again (both directions, before and after Original); working row changes to Ranger / ALL AVAIL; issued credits unchanged until AL1; named Ranger/No pays 0 to everyone, placeholder/Yes pays HO* to each of the four; undo/redo/reload agree. Changed through the calendar card's editor, not the List pencil.

Empty Saturday issued; Event ALL AVAIL filed (2 pending, credits 0); AL1 -> HO* on Sat; bar dragged to Sunday asks a fresh OIL question for Sunday, Sat HO* kept until AL2 (then 0); Sunday HO* only once Sunday is issued; delete leaves Sunday HO* until its AL1 (then 0). Undo/redo/reload agree. 'Compare with filing before Original' was not walked.

On a WEEKEND day, taking a not-yet-issued request off, deleting a dormant (taken-off) request, or moving it off the date each leave '1 pending - what this day earns changed' and wipe the four sign-offs, instead of 0 pending with sign-offs kept. Same with a named man's Duty (not placeholder-only); a weekday control (named Training on Wed) correctly reads 0 and keeps the sign-offs. No OIL is credited from the dormant request (credits 0 after AL1). Control (request present in the issued programme, taken off) reads pending as expected.

role: admin filer; member bell checked in place
said: Weekday placeholder Duty with no answer; Original issued, credits 0. PH declared (Leave War gear > Calendar > Holidays): day reads 1 pending, credits still 0; the filer's bell lights, a member's (Ranger) does not; bell tap opens the question; Yes then AL1 -> HO* each; PH removed: credits stay HO*, day reads '1 pending - what this day earns changed'; AL2 -> 0. Declaring before the first issue behaves the same. The PH removal is undoable and replays.

Part A: after Ranger is archived the ISSUED July 18 day (placeholder Duty, Ranger only in the crowd) reads '1 pending' with the line 'Ranger - posted out: no -> yes', and the four sign-offs clear; expected no crowd-only pending (D327). July credits (HO*) and the frozen crowd (45) stay; a future issued weekend (10 Oct) drops Ranger from the working crowd (46 -> 45), keeps his HO* until AL1, then he shows PO. A day with no placeholder reads 0 pending after the same archive. Part B PASS: deleting a test person (two-tap) leaves July face 0 pending, count 46 and his credit; the re-created callsign is a new person with a new id and no July cell/credit and is not in the frozen crowd.

Original with 09:00-16:00 Yes: all four FO*. Logic > Edit rules > full-day threshold 6h01 -> 8h: day reads 1 pending, changes window names 'Logic - Full-day OIL threshold 6h01 -> 8h' and each man 'full day -> half day'; credits stay FO* until AL1, then HO*. Undo ('a rule on the Logic page'), redo, reload agree.

Member: issued face labelled 'Original - as issued' with crowd 45; 'Working draft - not issued' shows 44 and Ranger's leave with a banner; unpublished Sunday Event (ALL) shown. Guest (new test account, guest switch on): sees Saturday ORIG with ALL AVAIL 45 and the Event row, Sunday DRAFT with ALL; no working-draft picker, no pending button, no editor; tapping the count or puck opens nothing. Credits stay HO* until amendment. Set-up and issuing were done on the phone context.

Inputs List export keeps the saved person and kind (ALL AVAIL / Duty, Ranger / Event) with current remarks. The schedule CSV and the print/PDF carry flying lines only - no Ground, placeholder or Event row at all (the promised Event Ground print surface does not exist in this build; recorded). A published flying day with a pending edit prints/exports its issued face (the pending mission text is absent from both).

HO* (Original) -> 0 (AL1, answer No) -> FO* (AL2, answer Yes + end 16:00); each step replay-checked and reloaded; previewing Original and AL1 afterwards changes no balance and the face stays AL2. 'EOD' has no control in this build, so AL2 stood in for the final issue.
